base_url.label: Instance URL
base_url.description: The URL of your Twenty instance (e.g. https://app.twenty.com). The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

create_contact.label: Create Contact
create_contact.description: Creates a new person record in your Twenty CRM workspace.

create_company.label: Create Company
create_company.description: Creates a new company record in Twenty CRM.

create_opportunity.label: Create Opportunity
create_opportunity.description: Creates a new opportunity (deal) in Twenty CRM.

stage.label: Stage
stage.description: The current stage of the opportunity.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: The monetary value of the deal.

currency.label: Currency Code
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).

companyId.label: Company ID
companyId.description: The ID of the company associated with this opportunity.

update_company.label: Update Company
update_company.description: Updates an existing company record in Twenty CRM.

companyId.label: Company ID
companyId.description: The ID of the company to update. Use the "Find Company" action to look this up.

twenty_list_objects.label: List Objects
twenty_list_objects.description: Lists the standard and custom objects in the workspace.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return.

startingAfter.label: Starting After
startingAfter.description: Cursor for the next page: pass `pageInfo.endCursor` from the previous call, with the same filters. Omit for the first page.

twenty_get_object.label: Get Object
twenty_get_object.description: Gets one object definition with its fields.

objectId.label: Object ID
objectId.description: UUID of the object (the `id` field), from List Objects. Not the object name.

twenty_list_fields.label: List Fields
twenty_list_fields.description: Lists field definitions across all objects in the workspace.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of fields to return.

startingAfter.label: Starting After
startingAfter.description: Cursor for the next page: pass `pageInfo.endCursor` from the previous call, with the same filters. Omit for the first page.

twenty_list_records.label: List Records
twenty_list_records.description: Lists or searches records of any object, with filter, sort and cursor paging.

objectNamePlural.label: Object
objectNamePlural.description: Plural API name of the object, e.g. "companies", "people", "opportunities", "tasks", "notes", or a custom object's plural name. Use List Objects (the `namePlural` field) to find it.

filter.label: Filter
filter.description: Twenty filter expression: field[comparator]:value, comma-separated for AND, or and(...), or(...), not(...). Comparators: eq, neq, in, containsAny, is (NULL / NOT_NULL), gt, gte, lt, lte, startsWith, endsWith, like, ilike (% wildcard). Composite fields use dot paths. Examples: emails.primaryEmail[eq]:"ada@example.com", name.firstName[eq]:"Ada", domainName.primaryLinkUrl[ilike]:"%acme%", stage[in]:["MEETING","PROPOSAL"], createdAt[gte]:"2026-01-01". Use deletedAt[is]:NOT_NULL to find soft-deleted records.

orderBy.label: Order By
orderBy.description: Sort expression: field[direction], comma-separated. Directions: AscNullsFirst, AscNullsLast, DescNullsFirst, DescNullsLast. Example: createdAt[DescNullsLast].

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-200). Defaults to 60.

startingAfter.label: Starting After
startingAfter.description: Cursor for the next page: pass `pageInfo.endCursor` from the previous call, with the same filters. Omit for the first page.

depth.label: Depth
depth.description: Relation depth: 0 returns only the record's own fields (relations as ids), 1 also embeds directly related records. Defaults to 0.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return, e.g. "id,name,emails,companyId". `id` is always returned. Omit to return every field.

twenty_get_record.label: Get Record
twenty_get_record.description: Gets one record of any object by its id.

objectNamePlural.label: Object
objectNamePlural.description: Plural API name of the object, e.g. "companies", "people", "opportunities", "tasks", "notes", or a custom object's plural name. Use List Objects (the `namePlural` field) to find it.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: UUID of the record, from List Records, Create Record or Get Record (the `id` field).

depth.label: Depth
depth.description: Relation depth: 0 returns only the record's own fields (relations as ids), 1 also embeds directly related records. Defaults to 0.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return, e.g. "id,name,emails,companyId". `id` is always returned. Omit to return every field.

twenty_delete_record.label: Delete Record
twenty_delete_record.description: Deletes one record of any object, softly by default.

objectNamePlural.label: Object
objectNamePlural.description: Plural API name of the object, e.g. "companies", "people", "opportunities", "tasks", "notes", or a custom object's plural name. Use List Objects (the `namePlural` field) to find it.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: UUID of the record, from List Records, Create Record or Get Record (the `id` field).

permanent.label: Permanent
permanent.description: Permanently destroy the record instead of moving it to the trash. Cannot be undone. Defaults to false.

objectNamePlural.label: Object
objectNamePlural.description: Plural API name of the object, e.g. "companies", "people", "opportunities", "tasks", "notes", or a custom object's plural name. Use List Objects (the `namePlural` field) to find it.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: UUID of the soft-deleted record, from List Records with the filter deletedAt[is]:NOT_NULL.
